context:
# Goal
maga-verify round 5 — independent evidence arm for fleet maga. You are ONE L2 probe lane in a 29-lane wave. Verify, never build: find what is broken, do not confirm what works. Forge landed ~10 defect fixes as UNCOMMITTED work — verify current bytes.

# Constraints
- Repo root: /home/vgpnk/Projects/MAKEARMORGAMESGREATAGAIN — your only surface.
- READ-ONLY on all source: NEVER edit files under MAGA-everything/, prototypes/, hardest/, or any source tree. NEVER run npm install / npm anything. NEVER start dev servers (all already running).
- You MAY write screenshots ONLY to verification/evidence/r05-<YourName>-*.png. Return your FULL verdict markdown as your final message regardless — the L1 judge integrates it.
- Browser: eval `browser.open({name:'<YourName>', url})` — ALWAYS pass a unique `name` for your tab (r4 lesson: unnamed tabs get hijacked by other lanes). Use tab.evaluate for page globals (tab.run can't see them). For file:// pages pass the full file:/// URL.
- Dev servers: boxhead :5173 · impossible :5174 · burger :5175 · chicken-invaders replica :5176 · chicken-invaders-original (cluck) :5177 · swords-and-sandals :5178.
- Evidence rule: every pass/fail carries an artifact (screenshot, console log, command output, measured value). Label inference. 'Not yet built' ≠ 'built wrong' — report schedule facts vs defects differently.

# Contract
Return markdown: ## Verdict (PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL|STATIC-ONLY) · ## Evidence (values, timings, file:line, screenshot paths) · ## Defects (new findings, numbered suggestions D-41+) · ## Notes.

items.name: BoxheadPause
items.prompt: Verify D-26 fix live: boxhead pause. Server http://localhost:5173. Source read-only: MAGA-everything/02-code/armor-games/apps/boxhead/src/game.ts (state 'paused' added ~line 307). Steps: start solo game; press Escape (or P) mid-run → expect PAUSED banner 'ESC / P — resume · M / ENTER — menu'; confirm zombies/players frozen (sample positions across 2s); press Escape again → resumes; pause again → press M → returns to mode select. Also: does pause work during waveBreak? During 'dead'/'victory' screens (should NOT)? Record exact behavior + screenshots to verification/evidence/r05-BoxheadPause-*.png.

Screenshots to verification/evidence/r05-BoxheadD16-*.png.
